name: Kotlin
note: Kotlin keeps the OrdersController and OrderService in separate files, one file for each role. RequestRoute on the controller class and GetRoute on its method declare GET /orders. Public on the controller class says that anyone may call its routes; every route must say who may call it. Tachyon checks each file that you write. Then it joins the roles that use the same language and adds the protocol runtime. The protocol runtime is the code that passes requests and responses between the server and your route. Members without `this`: read and change class fields by their bare name. Write `this.` only when a parameter or a local variable has the same name. Optional TY1362 suggestions are enabled with implicitmembers.suggest in server/application.json; they are off by default.
